insights.one_liner: US tech and retail giant with about 1.5 million staff; several Dutch Amazon entities are recognised visa sponsors, with a software internship in Deventer.

culture.text: Stresses 'ownership': software interns own their code from design through deployment and operations.
A huge company of about 1.5 million employees (2023), headquartered in Seattle; CEO is Andy Jassy.

open.text: Three Dutch entities are IND recognised sponsors: Amazon CS Netherlands, Amazon Data Services Netherlands and Amazon Development Center (Netherlands).
Its one open job here, a software engineering internship in Deventer, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Staff grew from 566,000 in 2017 to 1,608,000 in 2021, then fell to 1,500,000 in 2023.
Revenue was USD 716.9 billion with net profit of USD 77.7 billion in 2025.
Opened its second own delivery station in the Netherlands, in Valkenswaard.

worth_knowing.text: Settled a US lawsuit over claims of slow deliveries to low-income areas.
Its Dutch country manager Eva Faict is leaving for Picnic in December.
Has received a BigBrotherAward, a privacy criticism prize.
